text:
maya: quick check — after bumping the clientlib to v11.x we saw a handful of streaming disconnects in prod. looks auth-related during rotation. any quick migration notes?

santiago: yep, v11 changed the default stream auth behavior. it now resolves the Authorization header per-chunk by default which can race with token refresh.

maya: ack. that explains the mid-stream closes. what's the recommended short-term mitigation for long-lived streams?

santiago: two options:
1) pin the bearer token for the stream lifetime (client-side) and refresh after the stream ends.
2) use the new config toggle to opt into per-stream auth (will be in a patch). we call the toggle `stream_auth_mode: per_stream` (default `per_chunk`).

olga: for our Go workers, pinning is tricky because we use context-based refresh. any idiomatic Go snippet?

santiago: Go example (pseudo):

```
// fetch token once and attach to request headers
token, _ := authSvc.GetToken(ctx)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
stream, _ := client.OpenStream(req)
// do not call authSvc.Refresh() from the same ctx while stream open
```

That avoids mid-stream header mutation.

ken: filing a tiny client patch that adds the `stream_auth_mode` enum + a `legacy_retry_behavior` toggle so teams can preserve pre-v11 retries. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/clientlib/pull/5001

maya: perfect. can you also add a migration snippet for Python and curl? support will ask.

ken: added. Python snippet shows pinning and how to set `stream_auth_mode` via config. curl example for manual long-polls included.

olga: question — we also noticed more 429s surfacing; did retry defaults change too?

santiago: yes. v11 reduces default retry attempts and narrows automatic retries to safe idempotent endpoints. non-idempotent calls now default to no-retry. the new flag `legacy_retry_behavior: true` restores old attempts (6->3 was the change by default).

maya: so customers will need to opt-in if they relied on the old aggressive retries. good to call this out in release notes.

product-ops: tagging product here — please include a short "breaking changes" callout in the release notes: auth semantics and retry defaults. customers with long streaming sessions should get clear mitigations.

ci-bot: CI: build 4892 exited with tests failing in `TestStreamAuthRotation` — investigating.

ken: updated unit tests to cover long streams + token TTL boundary. also added an integration test that simulates mid-stream refresh.

santiago: one more edge — streaming tokens that are rotated by an external IAM (KMS/HSM) can lead to Authorization header mismatch if per-chunk is used. recommend per-stream for long-lived customer sessions (>10m).

maya: can we include a short checklist for the internal SDK-upgrades doc? e.g., flags to set, snippets, monitoring to watch (disconnect rate, 4xx vs 5xx), and rollout plan.

ken: added checklist to PR description. checklist summary:
- For short streams (<30s): no change required.
- For medium streams (30s-10m): consider pinning token or set `stream_auth_mode: per_stream`.
- For long streams (>10m): prefer rolling streams + pre-refresh or per_stream plus refresh-after-stream strategy.
- If you depended on the old retry budget, set `legacy_retry_behavior: true` per-service.

olga: will notify platform teams that run long-running ingestion streams.

maya: i'll schedule a staged canary: 5% traffic with `stream_auth_mode: per_stream` flipped in staging, monitor disconnects for 2h, then expand.

ken: merging PR once CI passes and docs review done.

ci-bot: PR#5001 CI passed: 612 tests, 2 flaky skipped.

maya: merged and rolled out to staging canary. monitoring dashboard added: stream_disconnects, auth-refresh-errors, 429-rate.

olga: staging looks stable at 2h. moving to 25% canary.

maya: thanks all. follow-up: SDK docs team please publish a short migration guide with the exact config keys and code snippets.

product-ops: will add a customer-facing blurb and include recommended mitigations for enterprise customers.

ken: if any teams hit edge cases (esp. Go or Rust clients), post here and i'll prioritize patches.

maya: closing loop — great work everyone. :rocket:
